question: How does a Pod reference a ServiceAccount, and how is the ServiceAccount connected to RBAC permissions in the API schema?

ground_truth.answer: A Pod references a ServiceAccount via the serviceAccountName field in PodSpec — the KG represents this with a USES_SERVICE_ACCOUNT edge from PodSpec to ServiceAccount. ServiceAccount is defined by its name within a namespace; its automountServiceAccountToken field (boolean) controls whether the token is projected into Pods. On the RBAC side, a RoleBinding grants permissions to the ServiceAccount by listing it in its subjects field (a Subject with kind ServiceAccount, name, and namespace) and referencing the permission set via roleRef (a RoleRef with kind, apiGroup, and name).
context: io.k8s.api.core.v1.PodSpec: serviceAccountName field references the ServiceAccount whose identity is made available to containers in this Pod
io.k8s.api.core.v1.ServiceAccount: provides an identity for Pod processes; automountServiceAccountToken controls whether the token is automatically projected into Pods
io.k8s.api.rbac.v1.RoleBinding: subjects field lists the ServiceAccounts (and users/groups) being granted permissions; roleRef identifies the Role or ClusterRole
